description: Close an open investigation with the team's reason, only when the user asks. Future investigations read the note. expected, wrong and not_useful keep the subject quiet for 30 days unless it gets materially worse. Preview returns the case and what closing it does; apply with confirmed=true after user approval. No tool reopens it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID from list_investigations, list_insights (investigationId), or Slack.

reason.description: expected: the team knew or intended it. wrong: the analysis is not right. not_useful: real but not worth attention. already_fixed: fixed outside Databuddy.

name: dismiss_investigation

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. investigation is the case a preview would close; success confirms an applied mutation. reply records an applied dismissal and its reason in the case timeline.

title: Dismiss investigation
